name: Unity Lifecycle Catalog
description: The seven lifecycle phases (Concept -> Systems Design -> Technical Setup -> Pre-Production -> Production -> Polish -> Release). Each step names the command that realises it and, where progression is machine-checkable, an artifact check (glob + required pattern). Steps whose completion cannot be auto-detected carry a human `note` fallback; optional steps are marked `required: false`.

phases.label: Concept
phases.description: Develop the game idea into a documented concept and establish the project baseline.

steps.name: Project Baseline
steps.description: Scan the Unity project and record its structure so later phases read evidence, not guesses.

steps.name: Architecture Baseline
steps.description: Author the architecture baseline from the scanned structure and package set.

steps.name: Concept Plan
steps.description: Optional: capture the concept as a feature plan before systems design.

phases.label: Systems Design
phases.description: Decompose the concept into systems and choose the composition patterns.

steps.name: Systems Map
steps.description: Map the systems and primitives, and check the composition graph for cycles and unresolved references.

artifact.note: Review the composition graph for cycles and unresolved primitives.

steps.name: Contract Design
steps.description: Validate every capability contract so the design and the registry agree.

artifact.note: Every capability contract validates with no errors.

steps.name: Pattern Selection
steps.description: Optional: select the enabled programming patterns and resolve conflicts.

artifact.note: Pattern conflicts are surfaced, never silently chosen.

phases.label: Technical Setup
phases.description: Compile clean, establish a log baseline, and index the code before production.

steps.name: Compile Baseline
steps.description: Compile the project and confirm fresh assemblies, not a silent no-op.

steps.name: Log Baseline
steps.description: Record the Editor log digest so new errors can be distinguished from pre-existing ones.

steps.name: Code Index
steps.description: Optional: index symbols/declarations for offline navigation.

artifact.note: Symbol lookup returns file:line with the Editor closed.

phases.label: Pre-Production
phases.description: Plan the work and its tests before implementing.

steps.name: Feature Plan
steps.description: Author the feature plan (context, design, test cases, testing decisions).

steps.name: Test Plan
steps.description: Assemble the per-feature test plan from the capability contracts.

steps.name: Scene Scaffold
steps.description: Optional: scaffold or restructure the scene/prefab for the feature.

artifact.note: Targeted edits only; no broken GUID references.

phases.label: Production
phases.description: Implement features through the change loop with cited evidence.

steps.name: Implement Feature
steps.description: Implement the scoped feature and wire it into the scene/prefab.

artifact.note: Feature diff reviewed against the plan and acceptance criteria.

steps.name: Change Loop
steps.description: Run resolve -> inspect -> change -> compile -> logs -> tests -> observe and cite the evidence.

steps.name: Coordinate
steps.description: Optional: claim resources and the Editor hold for multi-agent work.

phases.label: Polish
phases.description: Run the suite, remove redundant tests, and profile.

steps.name: Test Suite
steps.description: Run the full EditMode/PlayMode suite and record the verification report.

steps.name: Deduplicate Tests
steps.description: Optional: merge/remove redundant tests without trading coverage for tidiness.

artifact.note: Every removal recorded; same condition + same assertion only.

steps.name: Performance Pass
steps.description: Optional: profile CPU/GPU/memory bottlenecks.

artifact.note: Bottlenecks profiled against the performance budget.

phases.label: Release
phases.description: Gate, build, and record the release baseline.

steps.name: Verification Gate
steps.description: Run the verification gate and record the gate state.

steps.name: Build
steps.description: Build the project and record the verification report.

steps.name: CI Baseline
steps.description: Optional: record the CI status baseline for the release.
